overview.description: The ProShares Ultra Platinum K-1 Free ETF (UPLT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in platinum commodities. The fund seeks 2x the daily performance of platinum prices through derivatives linked to platinum exposure. The strategy uses swaps and cash collateral rather than investing directly in physical platinum UPLT was launched on Apr 20, 2026 and is issued by ProShares.

data.title: ProShares Launches First ETFs Targeting 2x Daily Returns of Platinum and Palladium
data.text: BETHESDA, Md.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--ProShares announced the first ETFs targeting 2x daily returns of platinum and palladium, and introduced an ETF targeting 2x daily returns of copper.
